findings.source_text: title: Four-cocycle twisted monoidal structure on 2Vect_G
findings.rendered: The title displays 2Vect_G with a literal underscore; the subscript is not typeset.
findings.repair: Typeset the notation as $2\mathrm{Vect}_G$ (or use equivalent title formatting supported by the renderer).

existing_math_diagrams_checked.checks: The tikzcd has vertices 1 and 2, with two parallel arrows oriented 1→2, separately labelled a and b (upper and lower). This matches the text specifying two distinct arrows from 1 to 2; no reversal or label collision visible.

The diagram moves H_fixed→H_pair by F_i, applies Π_s in the pair-first basis, then returns H_pair→H_fixed by F_i^{-1}; the curved composite is P_{i,s}. This agrees with P=F_i^{-1}Π_sF_i under the stated column-coordinate convention. It does not imply a permutation of ordered inputs. No direction, inverse, or label error observed.

optional_candidates.candidate: Draw f:A→B and g:B→C with point 2-cells α:f⇒f′ in B(A,B) and β:g⇒g′ in B(B,C), then the induced horizontal composite β∗α:g∘f⇒g′∘f′ in B(A,C). Keep the object tensor A⊗C visually separate from the 1-morphism composite g∘f.
optional_candidates.why_warranted: The example’s precise purpose is to prevent confusion between separately typed composition and tensor product; a compact pasting diagram could make the matching endpoints and source/target of the composite immediate.
optional_candidates.status: optional, source-supported; prose already states all types, so not required

optional_typography.note: The title uses plain “sl2” and “ell=4”; this is legible and not a rendering failure, but mathematical typography could typeset the notation.

editorial.intentional_technique_banners_and_wikili: Uppercase technique banners render as expected. Wikilink titles intentionally appear as standalone block links; adjacent punctuation/parenthesis wrapping is part of the renderer output and was not treated as reference-title leakage.

visual_summary.latex_and_mathmarkdown: Assigned body formulas generally render as KaTeX with correct indices and operators. One confirmed raw underscore occurs in the 2Vect_G item title. No standalone clipping was confirmed in the assigned original-resolution tiles.
visual_summary.tikz: The two assigned TikZ diagrams render. Capture metadata lists one tikzcd in the Kronecker counterexample; visual review also found the anyonic projector tikzcd. Their maps and orientations agree with source definitions.
visual_summary.scratch: No Scratch sections were identified in the assigned sources.
visual_summary.reference_titles: No reference-title leaks into item titles or body labels were observed. Wikilinks render as intentional block lines.
visual_summary.clipping: No confirmed clipping in assigned items from individually opened original tiles. Long ItemBodies continue across numbered tiles in numeric order; all continuation tiles were opened individually.
visual_summary.ascii_math: Confirmed raw title notation is 2Vect_G (literal underscore) in def-four-cocycle-twisted-monoidal-structure-on-2vect-g. “sl2” and “ell=4” in ex-su2-ell-four-modular-data are separated as optional typography.
